source: Speaker Session\Empowering Intelligent Solution Applications using Intel® OpenVINO™ Toolkit
title: Making AI deployment hands-on
place: Symbiosis Institute of Technology (SIT) · Lavale, Pune, Maharashtra
summary: A practical OpenVINO workshop for 60+ students and faculty, moving from image classification to LLM inference and a basic chatbot API.
detail: Introduced the toolkit architecture and inference across CPUs, GPUs and edge devices. Participants installed OpenVINO, ran the Hello Image Classification demo, explored LLM inference and developed a basic chatbot API.
outcome: Connected AI concepts to runnable applications on everyday laptops, with live coding, questions and a short quiz. Organized with IEEE SIT Pune, IEEE CEDA Bombay Section – Nagpur Chapter and the Intel OpenVINO Developer Community.
